title: Canadian Petition to Expel U.S. Ambassador Pete Hoekstra Takes Off
summary_full: Mr. Hoekstra has been President Trump’s faithful messenger in Canada amid a historic low in relations. More than 160,000 Canadians want him gone.
summary_public: Mr. Hoekstra has been President Trump’s faithful messenger in Canada amid a historic low in relations. More than 160,000 Canadians want him gone.
